{"consolidated_memory":"## Blank Render Issues in ui/components/DataTable.tsx (Multiple Occasions)

All blank render incidents in this component share a common signal: an empty tbody with no console error. Reproduction method across all occasions: open the table with a saved column layout. All fixes were deployed via separate PRs and branches.

### Occasion 1: [2026-02-02] Timezone Mismatch
**Trigger:** Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
**Root cause:** Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
**Fix:** Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #4145, branch fix/blank-render-1)
**Outcome:** Backlog cleared 8 minutes after deploy

### Occasion 2: [2026-02-04] Connection Pool Exhaustion
**Trigger:** Two requests racing on the same key (burst load condition)
**Root cause:** Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
**Fix:** Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #4576, branch fix/blank-render-2)
**Outcome:** Alert stayed quiet for 34 consecutive days

### Occasion 3: [2026-02-11] Missing Database Index
**Trigger:** Records carrying non-ASCII names
**Root cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
**Fix:** Added the composite index and backfilled data in batches (PR #5044, branch fix/blank-render-3)
**Outcome:** Backfill job finished in 32 minutes instead of 2 hours

### Occasion 4: [2026-03-24] Off-by-One Slice Error
**Trigger:** Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
**Root cause:** Off-by-one in the slice bound
**Fix:** Corrected the bound and added a property test around it (PR #5483, branch fix/blank-render-4)
**Outcome:** Nightly rollup matched source counts for 10 consecutive days

### Occasion 5: [2026-04-01] Missing Unicode Normalisation
**Trigger:** Sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
**Root cause:** Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
**Fix:** Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #6840, branch fix/blank-render-5)
**Outcome:** Throughput rose 61 percent, reaching 547 requests per second

### Occasion 6: [2026-07-09] Unwrapped Transaction
**Trigger:** Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
**Root cause:** Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
**Fix:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #8367, branch fix/blank-render-6)
**Outcome:** Reclaimed 60 GB of blob storage"}
